scripts.clean:temp: vrs clean data work target log
scripts.reset:all: vrs clean data work target log upload && npm run build && npm run import
scripts.reset: npm run clean:temp && npm run build && npm run import
scripts.reset:devel: vrs db drop -emptydb && npm run update:devel
scripts.build:full.clean: npm run clean:temp && npm run build
scripts.update:devel: npm run build:devel && vrs import modules -schemadevel
scripts.zip:release: vrs backup target/infradash-NPM_PACKAGE_VERSION-release-zip full native db upload -dbformat json
scripts.build:release: npm run build:full.clean && npm run import && npm run zip:source && npm run zip:update && npm run zip:release
scripts.release: npm run build:release && npm run upload:release
scripts.release:full: npm run build:release && npm run compile:demo.installer && npm run upload:release
